title: Single-/Multi-Channel Calibration - Opentrons Tips
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach appropriate pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette or the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette on the OT‑2, depending on which calibration test you will run.

steps.title: Load labware onto deck
steps.instruction: Place an Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack in slot 1 and the Simport Scientific 500 µL tubes in their custom holder in slot 3.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, specify the pipette type (single‑channel or multi‑channel) and any other required parameters for the calibration transfers.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the protocol file from the OT‑2 Run App after entering the parameters.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file back into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the deck map, confirming that the tip rack and tube holder are in the correct slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT‑2 Run App to calibrate the tip rack, the tube holder, and the attached pipette following the standard calibration workflow.

steps.title: Run calibration transfers
steps.instruction: Press “Run” to execute the calibration protocol, which performs the following liquid transfers:

substeps.instruction: If using the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette: transfer 5 µL from well A1 to wells A2, A3, and A4 with a 200 µL filter tip; then transfer 50 µL from well B1 to wells B2, B3, and B4 with a 200 µL filter tip; finally transfer 200 µL from well C1 to wells C2, C3, and C4 with a 200 µL filter tip.

If using the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette: transfer 5 µL from column 1 to columns 2, 3, and 4 with 200 µL filter tips; then transfer 50 µL from column 5 to columns 6, 7, and 8 with 200 µL filter tips; finally transfer 200 µL from column 9 to columns 10, 11, and 12 with 200 µL filter tips.
